title: 第二十三章 那些人那些事本集终第二集 众生相 第一章 名叫红雨的姑娘
lines: 一缕缕闪电在身体内部，沿着真气图游走，融入身体每一个窍穴，身体开始朝‘雷霆神体’转化。
孟川睁开了眼，拿起身旁放着的一玉盒，打开玉盒，将里面那一枚冰心果拿起来就两口啃掉吃掉，入口便融化，有冰凉力量顺着喉咙进入腹部，跟着逐渐朝身体各处弥漫，孟川身体的筋骨肌肉脏腑在汲取这冰凉力量后，又融入闪电后，蜕变明显在加剧。
“还有星灵草。”孟川又打开木盒，将里面完整的星灵草采摘下一片叶子、一根根须，这就差不多是一份的量了。一个月差不多吃完。
轻轻啃吃着叶子、根须，口腔中满是清香，精神都一震。
有神奇的力量先是涌入头脑，跟着才缓缓传达全身每一处，令肉身蜕变继续加强。
虽然不知道‘冰心果’、‘星灵草’到底是怎么来的，但是父亲凡事都笑呵呵，从不诉苦的脾气，都说了一句‘得来都不易，你务必珍惜。’恐怕得来是真的非常非常不容易，背后的代价怕也很大。自己能做的，就是不辜负他们的希望。
在接下来一个月里。
孟川按照计划修炼着，也服用了那一滴神魔玉髓液，星灵草全部吃完。并且他每天八千次‘拔刀式’以及身法刀法修炼，也从来没停过。
因为按照秘籍中所记载，在修炼神魔体初期，身体还在蜕变中，这时候如果拼命修炼某一个方向……身体也会更倾向于朝这一方向蜕变。就像是一株成长中的树苗，如果将它压弯向一个方向，它可能长成后也是歪向这一方向。
“神魔体的蜕变，明显放缓了。”六月底的一天，孟川正在练武场坐在那吃着西瓜。
“刚修炼的第一个月，本就是爆发期，我还服用三大奇珍。提升实在太快了，快的有些匪夷所思。现在缓慢增长才是正常的。”孟川感慨，“我的神魔根基的确够深厚，仅仅脱胎境前期……论肉身和真气都能媲美脱胎境圆满了。”
要知道，脱胎境是凡俗五重境界中提升幅度最大的，毕竟是初次修炼神魔体，逐渐拥有神魔的力量。
能脱胎前期就媲美脱胎圆满，这根基的确雄浑的恐怖。
就算‘脱胎境’到‘无漏境’是大境界突破，估摸着孟川在脱胎境后期，在身体真气方面就能匹敌无漏境了……这样的情况，在整个东宁府暂时都是没有的。一般也就王都、元初山等地方，得到古老神魔家族大力栽培的天才们才有如此神魔根基。
“川儿，川儿。”孟大江的声音遥遥传来。
“爹。”孟川放下西瓜，拿起毛巾擦了下嘴巴便立即跑过去。
很快就看到父亲孟大江和一名拄着拐杖的光头精瘦老者一同走来。
“三长老。”孟川一个激灵，整个孟家的长老中他最畏惧这位三长老。三长老为人冷酷古板，对待后辈最是凶，二话不说就挥动他的拐杖狠狠揍小辈。小辈们都有些畏惧。
“川儿，还不过来拜见三长老。”孟大江说道。
孟川立即上前，行礼：“见过三长老。”
光头精瘦老者看看孟川，见孟川衣服都汗水湿透了，这才满意点头，“修行就得用心，没有足够汗水，怎么能变强？”
“是。”孟川乖乖应道，和三长老在一起一定要乖乖听话，千万不能顶嘴。敢顶嘴，一拐杖就来了！
“这是我年轻时闯荡，机缘下得到的一张刀法残页。你可以看看。”光头精瘦老者从怀里拿出了用布小心包裹着的一张黑色纸张，将纸张连外面包裹着的布一起递给孟川。可仅仅打开后露出部分的那一张黑色纸张散发的恐怖气息，就让孟川、孟大江都一惊。
“神魔传承？”孟川他们都无比吃惊。
神魔传承，是需要一位极强大的神魔，付出很大代价才能记载下一份传承。
像孟仙姑、云家老祖等绝大多数神魔根本没有写下‘神魔传承’的资格。
“这太贵重了。”孟大江连道，“三叔，这我们不能收。”
三长老皱眉道：“我给的，必须收下！如果孟川悟性不够我还不会给他。他既然是我孟家如今唯一希望，他就必须得收下。而且这也不是完整的神魔传承，只是其中一张残页罢了。”
“好了，我回去了。”三长老拄着拐杖，转头就走，同时冷漠道，“孟川小子，你一定要争口气。别让大家失望。”
“是，三长老。”孟川握着这用布包裹着的黑色残页，颇有些感动。
一般神魔传承残页，拍卖都得十万两银子起！更别说这恰好是刀法，还更贵重。
并且这还是可遇不可求的！对古老神魔而言，银两已经没多大意义。没谁会将完整神魔传承去换些凡俗之物的。
“这一张神魔传承残页，应该是你三长老身上最珍贵之物了，他现在直接送给了你。”孟大江说道。
“嗯。”孟川点头，拨开布，看向那一张刀法残页。
黑色纸张上详细记载了这一招的施展诀窍，施展的关键之处。
content_en:
Wisps of lightning traveled inside the body, traveling along the Qi map, integrating into every acupuncture point of the body, and the body began to transform into the 'Thunder Divine Body'.
Meng Chuan opened his eyes, picked up a jade box next to him, opened the jade box, picked up the ice heart fruit inside and ate it in two mouthfuls. It melted in the mouth, and a cold force entered his abdomen along his throat, and then gradually spread to all parts of his body. After absorbing this cold force and integrating with the lightning, Meng Chuan's muscles, muscles and organs began to undergo transformation.
"And the Star Spirit Grass." Meng Chuan opened the wooden box again and picked out a leaf and a root from the complete Star Spirit Grass inside, which was almost a portion. I almost finished it in a month.
Gently nibbling the leaves and roots, your mouth is filled with fragrance, and your spirit is shaken.
There is a magical power that first pours into the mind, and then slowly spreads to every part of the body, causing the transformation of the physical body to continue to strengthen.
Although I don’t know where the ‘Bingxin Fruit’ and ‘Star Spirit Grass’ came from, my father smiled at everything and never complained, so he always said, ‘It’s not easy to get, so you must cherish it. ’ I’m afraid it’s really, really hard to get, and the price behind it is probably very high. All he can do is live up to their hopes.
…
over the next month.
Meng Chuan practiced according to the plan, also took the drop of the divine chalcedony liquid, and finished all the Star Spirit Grass. Moreover, he practiced the ‘Drawing Sword Posture’ and body and sword techniques eight thousand times a day, and he never stopped.
Because according to the secret book, in the early stages of cultivating the divine and demon body, the body is still undergoing transformation. If you practice hard in a certain direction at this time... the body will be more inclined to transform in that direction. Just like a growing sapling, if you bend it in one direction, it may also be bent in that direction when it grows up.
"The transformation of the divine and demonic bodies has obviously slowed down." One day at the end of June, Meng Chuan was sitting in the martial arts training ground eating watermelon.
"The first month of practice was the explosive period, and I also took the three great treasures. The improvement was too fast, and it was unbelievable. Now the slow growth is normal." Meng Chuan sighed, "My foundation of gods and demons is indeed deep enough. I am only in the early stage of the Rebirth Realm... In terms of physical body and true energy, it can rival the perfection of the Rebirth Realm."
You must know that the realm of rebirth is the greatest improvement among the five mortal realms. After all, it is the first time to practice the body of gods and demons, and gradually possess the power of gods and demons.
To be able to emerge from the human body in the early stage is comparable to being completely reborn. This foundation is indeed powerful and terrifying.
Even if it is a major breakthrough from the 'Reborn Realm' to the 'No Leakage Realm', it is estimated that Meng Chuan will be able to match the No Leakage Realm in terms of body energy at the late stage of the Reborn Realm... Such a situation does not exist in the entire Dongning Mansion for the time being. Generally speaking, only geniuses who have been vigorously cultivated by ancient gods and demon families in places such as Wangdu and Yuanchu Mountain have such a foundation of gods and demons.
"Chuan'er, Chuan'er." Meng Dajiang's voice came from afar.
"Dad." Meng Chuan put down the watermelon, picked up a towel, wiped his mouth and ran over immediately.
Soon I saw my father Meng Dajiang walking with a bald and lean old man on crutches.
"Third Elder." Meng Chuan was excited. Among all the elders of the Meng family, he was most afraid of this Third Elder. The third elder was cold and rigid, and treated his juniors the most harshly. He would beat the juniors severely with his cane without saying a word. The juniors were a little scared.
"Chuan'er, why don't you come over and pay homage to the third elder." Meng Dajiang said.
Meng Chuan immediately stepped forward and saluted: "I have met the third elder."
"Yeah."
The bald and lean old man looked at Meng Chuan and saw that Meng Chuan's clothes were soaked with sweat. Then he nodded with satisfaction, "You have to work hard to practice. How can you become stronger without enough sweat?"
"Yes." Meng Chuan responded obediently. When he is with the third elder, he must be obedient and must not talk back. If you dare to talk back, the crutch will come!
"This is a broken page of sword skills that I got by chance when I was young. You can take a look." The bald and lean old man took out a piece of black paper carefully wrapped in cloth from his arms, and handed the paper and the cloth wrapped outside to Meng Chuan. But the terrifying aura emanating from the partially exposed black paper after opening it startled both Meng Chuan and Meng Dajiang.
"Inheritance of gods and demons?" Meng Chuan and the others were extremely surprised.
The inheritance of gods and demons requires an extremely powerful god and demon to pay a great price to record the next inheritance.
Most gods and demons, such as Meng Xiangu and the ancestors of the Yun family, are not qualified to write down the "heritage of gods and demons".
"This is too valuable." Meng Dajiang said, "Third uncle, we can't accept this."
The third elder frowned and said: "What I give must be accepted! If Meng Chuan is not enlightened enough, I will not give it to him. Since he is the only hope of our Meng family now, he must accept it. And this is not a complete inheritance of gods and demons, just one of the broken pages."
"Okay, I'm going back." The third elder leaned on crutches, turned around and left, and said indifferently, "Boy Meng Chuan, you must fight for your reputation. Don't let everyone down."
"Yes, Third Elder." Meng Chuan was quite moved as he held the black fragment wrapped in cloth.
Generally, the broken pages of the inheritance of gods and demons can be auctioned for starting at one hundred thousand taels of silver! Not to mention that this happens to be a sword technique, which is even more valuable.
And this is still something you can never hope for! To the ancient gods and demons, silver no longer meant much. No one would exchange the complete inheritance of gods and demons for some mundane things.
"This fragment of the inheritance of gods and demons should be the most precious thing in your third elder's body. He has given it to you directly now." Meng Dajiang said.
"Yeah." Meng Chuan nodded, pushed aside the cloth, and looked at the remaining page of sword skills.
The black paper records the secret of performing this move in detail and the key points of its execution.
